summary: Reuse bounded agent-card status reductions between relevant claims.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule change.

compatibility.detail: Successful agent-card and public full-status responses retain their fields and snapshot semantics.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart; duration not measured for this change.
